name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires switch_toggled and reaching the exit, but only Existence(switch_toggled) appears; it does not make the agent reach the exit. The machine has a final state, but no clause makes it happen. Add a hard Existence(at_exit) and keep the hard Existence(switch_toggled).

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the switch to be flipped first, but the only Existence is the one on the exit. The compiled machine shows that the switch is toggled at the start (u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled -> u1) and at the exit (u0, at_exit&switch_toggled -> u3) - it is toggled both before and after the exit. The correct clause is Existence(switch_toggled) with hard priority. Add it; keep Existence(at_exit) with hard priority as it is correct.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the switch to be toggled and the exit to be reached, but no clause makes the switch happen. Add a hard Existence(switch_toggled) with a soft Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) that only toggles when the siren rings; keep the hard Existence(at_exit) with the rule-only warning, because it is a consequent of the task.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires reaching the exit with the switch flipped first, but no clause makes the agent flip the switch. Add a hard Existence(switch_toggled) with a hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) to make the agent flip the switch before reaching the exit.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task requires the switch to be toggled, and the clause makes it happen as a hard requirement.
